data.name: Singham
data.gender_notes: Singham is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word Singh meaning 'lion'. Singham is a powerful name that symbolizes strength and courage. It is believed to bring victory and success in life. The name Singham carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Telugu. Parents who choose Singham usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name associated with the lion deity, Singham is believed to represent the fearlessness and power of the lion. It is a name that inspires bravery and courage in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Singham belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Singham total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Singhs have been considered as the proud and valiant community in the Indian subcontinent. The name Singham shares the same valor and pride. It is a name that is synonymous with strength, valor, and fearlessness. The lion is the most revered animal in Hinduism, representing royalty, power, and fearlessness. Singham is a proud name for someone who aspires to embody the qualities of a lion.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the lion is considered a vehicle of God. Singham, being a name derived from the Sanskrit word Singh meaning 'lion', has a deep spiritual significance. It is believed that the name Singham summons the blessings of the divine, bringing strength, courage, and victory in the face of challenges. The lion represents the fierce and undying spirit within us. Singham is a name that inspires us to be fearless in the pursuit of our spiritual goals and to overcome our inner fears and weaknesses. It is a name that reminds us to be bold, courageous, and fearless in the face of life's challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Singham, meaning "lion-hearted," embodies the fearless and courageous spirit of a lion. It symbolizes one's inner strength and unwavering resolve to face challenges head-on. This name inspires the bearer to be bold and resilient, fearlessly confronting life's trials with unyielding determination.

historical_references.reference: Singham was a title given to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of the Maratha Empire in the Deccan region of India in the 17th century.
historical_references.context: The title Singham was given to Shivaji Maharaj due to his exceptional courage and strength in battle.

trends: Singam is a popular name for boys in India and other countries with Indian origin populations
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Singham remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Maya Singham from Delhi, India embodies the meaning of Singham - "Lion". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
